author: Cytokinesis
body:
Ign: Maganese
Reason: Void Logging
Reason I should be unbanned: This is more a clarification about the reason I was banned. I thought it was only combat logging that was against the rules e.g. disconnecting after being knocked into the void by another player. What I did was walk off the platform into the void like an idiot so I left and rejoined rather than wait to die and respawn. Is the rule just any kind of void logging? (not just when someone knocked you out but if you walk off yourself) If it is, I'm perfectly fine with the tempban, I broke a rule and should suffer the punishment, but if it's not could I please have the tempban retracted? (I know it's only 1 day but I prided myself on my lack of infractions)
I'd appreciate the clarification.

title: Tempban Appeal

replies.author: dilpickel
replies.body: Void logging is leaving the game before you die in the void regardless of how you end up there. Maybe I could bring it up in the next staff meeting to make the rule better cover this. A Srmod will give a result to your appeal soon.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Maganese,

Combat logging is the logging off or leaving your team in anticipation of dying. Therefore this appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
